full_judgment: 2. The relevant facts, for the disposal of this appeal, are that the plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No. 15 of 1992 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Barisal for declaration of title, confirmation of possession, in alternative, recovery of khas possession of the suit land and for further declaration that the mortgage deed dated 22.02.1902 is to be treated to have been redeemed stating, inter alia, that the land appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 157 of mouza Ashokati belonged to Mafezuddin and Entezuddin in equal share. Mafezuddin mortgaged the suit land to Osman Molla and Eslam Molla by a registered mortgage deed dated 22.02.1902 (Exhibit-B). Osman Mollan and Eslam Molla surrendered possession of the same to Mefezuddin in the last part of 1346 B.S. Mafezuddin died without any issue and his interest was devolved upon his brother Entezuddin. Thereafter, Entezuddin upon his brother Entezuddin. Thereafter, Entezuddin died leaving two sons, the plaintiff No.1 and Nowab Ali, the predecessor-in-interest of the plaintiff Nos.2-8 and one daughter, the defendant No. 18 who transferred her share in favour of the plaintiff No.1 and Nowab Ali. The plain-tiffs have been in exclusive possession of the suit land. R.S. record was wrongly prepared in the names of the defendants. The plaintiff No.1 Nowab Ali and the defendant No.18 settled 0.17 acre of land of C.S. Khatian No. 157 on 01.05.1939 to the defendant Nos. 15-17 which was recorded in their names in R.S. Khatin No. 536/1. The defendants No. 15-17 transferred the same in favour of the plaintiffs by a registered kabala deed on 10.03.1955 and put them into possession. During S.A. operation the said land was wrongly recorded in the names of the defendants. Hence, was the suit.
